objects.partial_state: a finite set of coordinate constraints with explicit unknowns
objects.completion_set: all total registered states satisfying the partial constraints
objects.disposition: a finite-valued function D on total states
objects.certificate: a subset of resolved facts/constraints whose logical closure makes D constant over every compatible completion

theorem_targets: T1 (exact licensing): commitment to d is sound and complete over a partial state p iff D(c)=d for every c in Comp(p)
T2 (non-identifiability): if two completions of p have different D values, no deterministic rule measurable only from p can be correct on both
T3 (monotonicity): once D is completion-invariant, adding truthful constraints cannot destroy that invariance unless the refined completion set is empty

T4 (finite minimal certificate): on a finite registered state family, every completion-invariant nonempty p has at least one inclusion-minimal certificate; each certificate intersects the coordinate-difference set of every opposite-disposition completion pair compatible with the un-certified base state

T5 (hitting-set dual): under coordinate-independent consistency, inclusion-minimal commitment certificates are exactly inclusion-minimal hitting sets of the registered opposite-disposition pair-difference hypergraph
hostile_controls: mixed completion fibre must block commitment
irrelevant resolved fact must not be required in a minimal certificate
contradictory/empty completion set must fail closed rather than prove any disposition
old_evidence_rule: R4 Active-VOI and costed-ordering outcomes are boundary/derivation evidence only. They are not theorem tests and cannot be reinterpreted as support.
